result.electromagnetism_biot_savart_law>{\"curr:
Using the Biot‑Savart law for an infinitely long straight conductor:

\[
B=\frac{\mu_0\,I}{2\pi r}
\]

where  
\( \mu_0 = 1.2566370614\times10^{-6}\,\text{H/m} \), \( I = 12~\text{A} \), and \( r = 8~\text{m} \).

Plugging in the numbers:

\[
B = \frac{(1.2566370614\times10^{-6})(12)}{2\pi(8)}
   \approx 9.5\times10^{-7}\;\text{T}.
\]

So the magnetic field at 8 m from the wire carrying 12 A is approximately **\(9.5\times10^{-7}\) tesla**.
